verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a REST API and an MCP server that expose "the same retrieval and synthesis surface that powers the web app," and shows API/MCP parity for filters such as excludePreprints. That parity claim covers only retrieval and synthesis, not the full UI. Nothing shows UI features like Library import and management, Citation Graph, Threads, Deep Search or the Consensus Meter are reachable programmatically. missing for 10: API coverage of Library/reference-manager import (Zotero, BibTeX, RIS), Citation Graph, Threads, Deep Search and Consensus Meter; endpoint-level API reference; independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.
